title: South Park Just Retconned a Major Character With Their Return & It’s a Big Improvement
content: South Park Season 29 has gone back on a major character change made last year, and it is a big improvement as PC Principal is now back to his more classic self with the latest episode. South Park Season 29 has been more of a return to form to the earlier seasons of the animated series.
author: ComicBook

title: Classroom of the Elite: Year 3 Tops Oricon's Light Novel Ranking for October
content: The anime adaptation's fourth and latest season debuted on April 1 and covers the first semester of the Year 2 light novels. The anime will get a fifth season . The second volume of Kinoko Nasu and illustrator Hirokazu Koyama 's Witch on the Holy Night novel series ranked at #2, selling 30,534 copies.
author: ANN

title: Kagurabachi Drops Cool New Look at Chihiro’s Anime Debut
content: Kagurabachi is setting itself up as one of the biggest new anime to make their worldwide debuts next year, and it’s getting even cooler with a much closer look at Chihiro Rokuhira ahead of his big outing.
author: ComicBook

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Season 2 Confirms Episode Release Schedule for 2027 Launch
content: Avatar: Seven Havens has not only confirmed Season 2’s release date ahead of its return in 2027, but the animated series has also revealed the release schedule for all of its future episodes.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Biggest Isekai Confirms Season 5 Return With First Look
content: One of the biggest Isekai franchises now streaming with Crunchyroll has now confirmed it’s coming back for Season 5 in the near future. The anime adaptation for Tappei Nagatsuki and Shinichirou Otsuka has been on an incredible run for the past decade as it now celebrates its 10th anniversary.
author: ComicBook

title: Love Live! Hasu no Sora Jogakuin School Idol Club Anime's Special Video Previews TV Footage
content: The " Love Live! Series 15th Anniversary Love Live! Fes" presented a special promotional video for the television anime of the Love Live! Hasu no Sora Jogakuin School Idol Club project on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: World Trigger Tops Oricon's Comic Ranking for October
content: The 30th volume of Daisuke Ashihara 's World Trigger manga topped the chart, selling 280,785 copies. The volume shipped in Japan on October 2. The manga's anime adaptation is getting a " Reboot Project " that will re-adapt the original manga from the first chapter and will include the Border Enlistment Arc,…
author: ANN

title: 'Toaru Anbu no Item' Reveals Additional Cast, Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kazuma Kamachi 's Toaru Anbu no Item ( A Certain Dark Side's Item ) light novel revealed additional cast and a promotional video on Saturday. The anime premiered on October 9 at 10.30 p.m. on AT-X, followed by Tokyo MX and BS11.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Love Live! Hasunosora Anime Reveals New Trailer
content: Love Live! Hasunosora Girls’ High School Idol Club anime revealed a new trailer on Saturday. The anime will premiere on January 10, 2027. Studio Sublimation is animating the series. Go Kurosaki is directing the series, with Haruko Iizuka on character designs, and Yoshiaki Fujisawa on music.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu' Gets 5th Season
content: The Re:Zero 10th Anniversary Starlight Party special event announced a fifth season on Saturday, revealing an ultra teaser visual (pictured). Produced by White Fox , the first anime season adapting Tappei Nagatsuki 's isekai fantasy light novel debuted in Spring 2016, covering the first nine volumes.
author: MyAnimeList
